posts.zh:
dsh-subagent-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-78d80c55b7dc3ebee6e0.html
posts.en:
dsh-subagent-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-78d80c55b7dc3ebee6e0.html
